question: Which members of the passing rank49 source graph remain individually redundant once the other 48 are present?
intervention: Starting from the frozen passing rank49 support, base-clamp one allowed head/module at a time. Measure retention of all eight weight-derived coordinates under both fits and retention of the rank49 native task effect.
ranking: Rank from most removable to least by the maximum across fits of coordinate impairment max(0,1-min projection) and native impairment max(0,1-min task projection), then site name.

predictions.pred_a_authority_baseline_replay_finiten: authorities replay, the rank49 source baseline is deterministic, all values are finite, and <=66 forwards execute
predictions.pred_b_at_least_ten_sites_are_individual: at least ten deletions retain coordinate and native projections >=0.99 under both fits
predictions.pred_c_removability_spans_all_four_bands: at least one individually removable component lies in each layer band
predictions.pred_d_early_mlp_chain_is_individually_r: deleting each of MLP0, MLP1, MLP2, MLP3, or MLP4 causes >=0.05 impairment under both fits
predictions.pred_e_removability_is_crossfit_stable: even/odd deletion-score rankings have Spearman correlation >=0.90 and top-20 least-removable overlap >=18

decision: Freeze the ascending-removability order for sequential backward deletion with the full joint coordinate, behavior, and control gates. This atlas alone does not remove components.
